jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original fantasy RPG transformation sprite animation. REFERENCE INPUT: provided 27.jpg is the sole character identity reference. Reproduce its DRAGON-HEADED armored humanoid, horned elongated reptilian dragon skull with glowing magenta eyes and jagged toothed mouth, NO human face and NO hair. Stocky muscular purple-black segmented dragon armor/scales, red-magenta diamond crystal in chest, TWO immense curved STEEL CLAW GAUNTLETS attached to forearms, glowing violet chains around wrists, two large dark purple bat dragon wings with small violet flames, armored digitigrade clawed feet. NO handheld swords/bows, NO white hair/elf. Crisp detailed hand-painted pixel-art game sprite, clear silhouette.
TRUE transparent RGBA background (not drawn checkerboard), no text, labels, grid, landscape, background wash or floor shadow. Exactly 12 full-body sprites in uniform 4 columns x 3 rows on landscape canvas 1536x1024. Same body scale and foot baseline for each row. Fit WHOLE character, wings, claws and small effects inside each equal cell with at least 20px empty margin, no neighboring overlap, no giant isolated projectile. Modest wing flex, character stays walking on ground.
Row1: four real walking phases left-foot contact, passing, right-foot contact, passing; arms swing naturally with claws lowered.
Row2: four visibly different melee attack keyframes: rear claw windup/coil torso, forward claw sweep with extension and modest violet claw trails, opposing claw heavy crossing strike with torso rotation, recover with claws lowered. Claws are integral gauntlets, hands change positions clearly; preserve head and back-facing identity; do not merely reuse stance with changing effects.
Row3 left two: casting charge with both claws by chest, release with both claws spread and compact purple fire/rune under feet. Row3 right two: physical hurt recoil and recover with claws low. Both claw gauntlets stay attached at all times. Purple flames small enough not to obscure armor or overlap cells.
DIRECTION: Every pose consistent 3/4 FRONT facing screen bottom. See dragon face and chest red crystal.
